title: Asynchronous 10-20x realtime speech-data reconciliation and model-improvement pipeline
goal: Separate low-latency speech inference from a substantially slower, higher-quality reconciliation and training path. Participant transcript/audio evidence may be reconciled, re-transcribed, aligned, validated and trained with a configurable compute budget of normally 10x to 20x source-audio duration, without blocking or degrading the active WebRTC call.

codebase_alignment.voice_runtime: Reuse voice_runtime streaming transcripts, candidate fusion, confidence reruns, segments, words, disagreement regions and provenance.
codebase_alignment.ml_intern: Reuse ML-Intern immutable datasets, deterministic splits, isolated training workers, capacity/execution leases, evaluation, approval, registry and rollback.
codebase_alignment.pair_sync: Reuse the E2EE peer speech-training-data sync inventory, provenance and conflict model instead of copying raw datasets without lineage.
codebase_alignment.worker_contracts: Reuse bounded worker contracts, task leases, fencing, cancellation and expected artifacts for asynchronous reconciliation jobs.
codebase_alignment.hard_boundary: The realtime transcript/audio transport must never wait for dataset reconciliation, model training, evaluation or participant synchronization.

principles: Realtime inference and offline learning are separate schedulers, queues and resource budgets.
The default reconciliation budget is 10x source duration and the normal configurable maximum is 20x.
A budget is an upper bound, not a requirement to consume all available time.
Best-so-far artifacts may be checkpointed, but only fully evaluated artifacts can be approved.
Participant devices may pause, resume or refuse offline work without breaking the call.
Battery, thermal pressure, interactive load and user-defined quiet hours override training throughput.
No unfinished or timed-out result silently replaces an active model.
Additional compute must be justified by measurable transcript, alignment or reconstruction improvement.

realtime_path.target: sub-second to a few seconds depending on negotiated delay

examples: 10 minutes source audio permits a default compute budget of up to 100 minutes
10 minutes source audio permits a configured maximum normal budget of up to 200 minutes

tasks.title: Define realtime/offline isolation contract
tasks.description: Specify separate queues, executors, priorities, cancellation semantics and state transitions for live speech and slow reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: No realtime service waits on an offline job future, lock, queue or database lease.
Realtime fallback remains available while reconciliation is queued, running, paused, failed or cancelled.
Offline states include queued, running, paused_resource_pressure, checkpointed, evaluating, completed, failed, cancelled and expired.
Identical ordered events produce deterministic states and reason codes.
Integration tests prove an intentionally stalled reconciliation worker does not increase live transcript latency.

tasks.title: Add bounded 10-20x reconciliation job schemas
tasks.description: Create strict schemas for source-duration-derived budgets, compute caps, checkpoints, results and quality deltas.
acceptance_criteria: realtime_factor_budget defaults to 10 and is bounded to 1-20 in the normal product profile.
Administrative research profiles above 20 require a distinct policy flag and are never selected implicitly.
wall-time, CPU/GPU time, memory, disk and checkpoint counts are bounded independently.
Schemas contain consent and immutable input-manifest references.
Malformed, negative, overflow and stale budgets are rejected.

tasks.title: Implement source-duration compute budget planner
tasks.description: Translate admitted source duration, selected realtime factor and available participant/server resources into bounded stage budgets.
acceptance_criteria: 10 minutes at factor 10 yields at most 100 minutes total planned compute-equivalent budget.
10 minutes at factor 20 yields at most 200 minutes total planned compute-equivalent budget.
Budgets are divided among ASR ensemble, alignment, conflict resolution, filtering, training and evaluation.
Planner reserves mandatory evaluation and never lets training consume the entire budget.
Budget calculations are deterministic and integer-overflow safe.
Unused budget is not treated as failure.

tasks.title: Add checkpointable peer transcript reconciliation worker
tasks.description: Run slow multi-pass comparison of participant transcripts, source audio and provenance with resumable checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Worker can compare multiple ASR candidates and both participants' transcript revisions.
Word and segment alignment may be recomputed with slower algorithms than the live path.
Original participant records remain immutable and the reconciled record retains field-level provenance.
Worker checkpoints before lease expiry and resumes only with matching manifests and consent.
Cancellation prevents publication of late results.
No transcript or raw audio appears in progress events or general logs.

tasks.title: Implement quality-driven early stopping and budget extension rules
tasks.description: Stop when additional passes no longer improve useful metrics; permit movement from 10x toward 20x only when unresolved high-value conflicts justify it.
acceptance_criteria: Default runs begin with a 10x ceiling or lower user/resource cap.
Extension toward 20x requires unresolved conflicts plus a measured improvement trend.
Plateau, regression, excessive energy cost or insufficient evidence triggers early stop.
Policy retains enough budget for final held-out evaluation.
Reason codes explain early stop, extension, exhaustion and rejection.
AI-Snake may explain an extension proposal but cannot approve it outside deterministic policy.

tasks.title: Integrate reconciliation outputs with immutable ML-Intern dataset versions
tasks.description: Publish a new dataset version only after reconciliation completes its admission gates; never mutate existing participant datasets in place.
acceptance_criteria: Output manifest references every contributing participant manifest and reconciliation result digest.
Resolved and unresolved conflicts are counted and traceable without exposing content in logs.
Train/validation splits are regenerated leakage-safely for the new immutable version.
A timeout or partial checkpoint cannot become a trainable dataset unless explicitly curated under a separate incomplete-data policy.
Revocation can identify all derived dataset versions transitively.

tasks.title: Schedule training only after reconciliation admission
tasks.description: Gate personalized training on the reconciled immutable dataset and remaining compute budget, while preserving ML-Intern approval and fencing semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Training never reads mutable peer buffers directly.
Training request includes reconciliation result and dataset manifest digests.
Remaining budget is checked before queue admission.
Insufficient budget yields a dataset-only result rather than a failed call or forced training run.
Training, evaluation and artifact publication obey existing lease, fencing, cancellation and approval rules.

tasks.title: Add participant resource-aware pause and resume
tasks.description: Pause or migrate optional participant work during calls, high interactive load, battery pressure or thermal throttling.
acceptance_criteria: Live call, foreground application and user resource caps have higher priority than reconciliation.
Participant can choose immediate, idle-only, charging-only, scheduled or disabled offline processing.
Pause creates a verified checkpoint and releases compute leases.
Resume rejects stale consent, manifests, epochs or model versions.
No participant is penalized functionally for refusing compute contribution.

tasks.title: Expose slow-path progress and AI-Snake explanations
tasks.description: Show source duration, selected factor, estimated budget allocation, completed stages, checkpoints, quality gains and remaining conflicts without suggesting that the live call is waiting.
acceptance_criteria: UI clearly labels the process as asynchronous and non-blocking.
Users can reduce the factor, pause, cancel or disable future reconciliation.
10x and 20x are explained as maximum compute budgets relative to source duration.
Progress does not expose partner transcript or audio content outside granted views.
AI-Snake recommendations remain proposals and cannot extend budgets or activate models directly.

tasks.title: Benchmark quality gain per compute factor and enforce release gates
tasks.description: Compare 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x and 20x reconciliation budgets and measure whether additional compute improves datasets and models enough to justify cost.
acceptance_criteria: Report separates reconciliation, training and evaluation compute.
Metrics include transcript conflict reduction, alignment error, admitted evidence, held-out intelligibility, lexical fidelity, reconstruction quality, energy and wall time.
Marginal improvement from 10x to 20x is reported explicitly.
Release defaults do not select 20x when measured gains are negligible.
A saturated offline queue does not measurably regress live transcript, audio or UI latency.
Ordinary encrypted WebRTC and existing models remain operational throughout benchmark failure scenarios.

definition_of_done: Live inference remains independent from all reconciliation and training jobs.
A configurable source-duration-derived budget supports the normal 10x to 20x range.
Participant transcripts and training data are reconciled into new immutable, provenance-complete dataset versions.
Jobs checkpoint, pause, resume, cancel and expire safely under resource pressure and consent changes.
Training starts only from admitted reconciled datasets and remains subject to evaluation, explicit approval and rollback.
Benchmarks demonstrate quality gain per compute factor and prove that offline saturation does not harm the call.
